Ria: Quick heads-up — bringing up sable-v2q (int8) in canary. Parse failures for function/tool JSON calls jumped ~+3.2% vs fp32 baseline, concentrated in streaming responses and when long KV prefixes are attached. Unsure if tokenizer or runtime emission.

Sam: Paste a sanitized sample?

Ria: Example (sanitized): 
```
...
{"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "find user\u0000name==\"alice\""}}
...
ERROR parse_json: unexpected token '\u0000' at byte 123
```

Tess: Embedded nulls — might be KV-cache prefix not cleaned when quantized tokenizer emits control characters. Saw similar in micro-PTQ runs.

Andre: Could also be int8 dequant rounding producing stray control/whitespace tokens mid-stream; streaming parser then sees non-UTF8 bytes.

Ria: Telemetry snapshot (canary run 03/20): parse_fail_rate int8: 2.8% -> 6.0% (fp32: 2.7%). Short link: https://telemetry/redwood/sable-v2q-canary

Sam: Two low-risk mitigations to try in parallel: 1) disable KV-prefixing for the canary bucket; 2) add pre-parse sanitizer that strips C0 control bytes (including �).

Tess: Also add an NDJSON-rescue parser fallback: split on '}
{' boundaries, wrap fragments and try reparsing. It's a pragmatic stopgap for funccalls.

Andre: Long-term we should run tokenization diagnostics with int8 kernels and log raw token bytes around control chars to detect table mismatches.

Ria: Ran sanitizer (strip C0 controls) on a small sample n=200. parse_fail reduced to +0.4% over fp32, but we introduced ~0.7% semantic mis-mapping where the tool name ended up as suffix text instead of a func call. Likely streaming boundary/retry ordering.

Sam: That implies partial flush / retry ordering issues — when retries resend prefix, function tokens can appear mid-stream and be interpreted as free text.

Tess: Patch plan: 1) cap retries to 1 for canary; 2) prefer earliest well-formed JSON object in function-mapper when multiple candidates; 3) run sanitizer pre-join before streaming start.

Andre: I'll add a sampled token-byte logger in the runtime to correlate raw token bytes -> unicode output -> parser errors. Low perf if sampled at ~0.1%.

canary-bot: Canary deploy started: sable-v2q-int8 (kvprefix-off + sanitizer + retry-cap) — run id c-3387654321.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Will surface canary metrics in ~30m.

Ria: Action items: Tess to run canary with kvprefix off + sanitizer + retry-cap; Sam to add NDJSON-rescue fallback and prefer earliest valid function object; Andre to enable sampled byte-logger; I'll gather 1k failing traces and attach to issue.

Sam: Adding temporary alert for parse-rate regressions >+1% vs baseline so we can roll back fast. :rotating_light:

Tess: Can running now, ETA ~25m. Will post updates here.

Ria: If this brings parse delta to acceptable range we'll keep int8 in canary but hold full rollout until tokenizer table audit completes.

Andre: If sanitizer + NDJSON-rescue removes parse failures but semantic mis-maps persist, consider a post-hoc structured-output reconciler that enforces schema and converts high-confidence textual matches back into deterministic function calls.

Ria: Keeping thread for canary follow-ups.
